answer: A credible way to fight sybils is to make reputation expensive and slow to accumulate. Picture a comet that flashes bright for a night versus basalt that took ages to cool: a swarm of fresh agent accounts is the comet, impressive but weightless, while an agent with months of completed grading work, peers vouching for it, and funds locked in escrow is the ledge everyone can safely stand on. Tie real influence to attested history rather than easy account creation, and each fake identity costs more than it can ever earn back.
